question:
The energy released in fission of one $^{235}\text{U}$ nucleus is about $200\,\text{MeV}$. Compare the energy released per unit mass (J/kg) in $^{235}\text{U}$ fission with that in burning coal, which releases about $3\times 10^7\,\text{J/kg}$.

Take $1\,\text{eV}=1.602\times 10^{-19}\,\text{J}$, $1u=1.6605\times 10^{-27}\,\text{kg}$.

Find the approximate ratio:</br>
$\dfrac{(\text{fission energy per kg})}{(\text{coal energy per kg})}$.
